{{Top|leg}}
'''Cryogen''' was a [[Gas/Legends|gas]] used in the field of medicine during the final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Typically inert until it was mixed with [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], Cryogen was used to freeze cells and tissue samples for later use. This substance became important during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when various cloned organs for [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] could be placed in cryogen for storage or transport across the galaxy.

The substance also had offensive purposes, being used with [[Rodian cryogen whip|whips]] by [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. When the weapons struck, they caused cold, near-explosive, chemical reactions capable of freezing metal in a single strike.

==Behind the scenes==
In the real world, "[[Wiktionary:cryogen|cryogen]]" is a generic term for a substance that is liquid at very low temperatures and that acts as a refrigerant.
